title: Nawaqid al-Islam: The Ten Nullifiers of Islam
description: Explanation of Imam Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's Nawaqid al-Islam (The Ten Nullifiers of Islam) - the deeds and sayings that remove a person from the fold of Islam. Every Muslim must learn what these nullifiers are to avoid them. Taught by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan (AMAU Academy).
short_description: The ten nullifiers that take a person out of the fold of Islam

modules.title: Introduction & Foundations
modules.description: What the nullifiers are, and the first set of nullifiers (1-5).

lessons.title: Part 1 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: Introduction to Nawaqid al-Islam: the purpose of the matn and the first nullifier - associating partners with Allah in worship. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 2 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The second nullifier: whoever sets up intermediaries between himself and Allah, calling on them, seeking closeness to them, and relying on them - has committed shirk. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 3 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The third nullifier: whoever does not declare the mushrikeen to be disbelievers, or doubts that they are disbelievers, or approves of their religion - has disbelieved. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 4 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The fourth nullifier: whoever believes that anyone's guidance is more complete than the guidance of the Prophet (peace be upon him), or prefers the judgement of other than his Shari'ah. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 5 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The fifth nullifier: whoever hates something that the Messenger (peace be upon him) brought - even if he acts on it; and the sixth: mocking anything of the religion of Allah, His reward, or His punishment. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

modules.title: The Nullifiers in Practice (6-10)
modules.description: The remaining nullifiers (6-10) and what removes a Muslim from Islam.

lessons.title: Part 6 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The seventh nullifier: magic - learning it, teaching it, practising it, or approving of it. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 7 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The eighth nullifier: supporting and assisting the mushrikeen against the Muslims. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 8 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The ninth nullifier: whoever believes that someone may lawfully go beyond the Shari'ah of Muhammad (peace be upon him), as al-Khidr went beyond the Shari'ah of Musa. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 9 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: The tenth nullifier: turning away from the religion of Allah entirely - neither learning it nor acting by it. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 10 — Explanation of the Ten Nullifiers of Islam
lessons.content: Conclusion of the ten nullifiers: a review of their proofs and applications, so that the student may guard himself from them. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf
